{"parse":{"title":"2026–27 Belgian Pro League","pageid":82560958,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{short description|124th season of top-tier football in Belgium}} {{Infobox football league season | image = Belgian Pro League logo (2020, horizontal).svg | competition = [[Belgian Pro League]] | season = 2026–27 | dates = 7 August 2026 – 23 May 2027 | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = [[2027–28 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = [[2027–28 UEFA Europa League|Europa League]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | continentalcup3 = [[2027–28 UEFA Conference League|Europa Conference League]] | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | league topscorer = | matches = | total goals = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Belgian Pro League|2025–26]] | nextseason = ''[[2027–28 Belgian Pro League|2027–28]]'' | updated = }}The '''2026–27 Belgian Pro League''' (officially known as the '''Jupiler Pro League''' due to sponsorship reasons) is the 124th season of top-tier football in [[Belgium]]. ==Format change== The Belgian Pro League is returned to a competition without playoffs, after 17 seasons of using the play-off system (in various forms, and with the exception of the [[2019–20 Belgian First Division A|2019–20 season]] when the playoffs could not be held due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]). Disputes and legal procedures against this decision have been running until mid-June 2026, mainly due to the fact that as part of the reform, a rule was introduced (during the ongoing 2024-25 season!) that at least four U23-teams would always remain in the Challenger Pro League (and hence could not be relegated unless another U23-team got promoted from the third level). This rule was abolished two seasons later, as it was judged to be illegal by the Belgian Competition Auhtority, and would result in a yearly fine of €12 million to the Pro League.{{Cite web|url=https://sporza.be/nl/2026/04/09/gaat-competitiehervorming-dan-toch-nog-op-de-schop-aa-gent-spant-twee-rechtszaken-aan-tegen-pro-league~1775717277736/|title=Gaat competitiehervorming dan toch nog op de schop? AA Gent spant twee rechtszaken aan tegen Pro League | sporza}} While this rule was abolished, the reform to 18 teams ultimately remained intact, to the dismay of some teams who argued that if one part of the package was cancelled, the whole reform should be cancelled. Furthermore, in a debate held in June 2026 between the largest six clubs (Anderlecht, Antwerp, Club Brugge, Genk, Gent, and Union SG), with the exception of Club Brugge, all club leaders acknowledged that a league with 18 teams is far from the best format for Belgium, as it is less interesting for the rights holders, has fewer clashes between big teams, and reduces fan interest throughout the season. Long-term they are aiming to reduce the number of teams in the highest division to 14 or fewer, and reduce the number of professional teams in Belgian football altogether.https://www.hln.be/belgisch-voetbal/exclusief-hln-debatteert-met-zes-grootste-clubs-over-toekomst-belgisch-voetbal-willen-we-nog-wel-meespelen-op-het-hoogste-niveau~a0ec7060/ In the end, the league will expand to 18 teams and be run as a round-robin tournament without playoffs. The bottom two teams will be relegated to the [[2027–28 Challenger Pro League]].{{cite web|last1=Hick|first1=Antoine|url=https://www.rtbf.be/article/reforme-de-la-pro-league-la-fin-des-play-offs-actee-a-partir-de-la-saison-2026-2027-11509820|language=french|title = Réforme de la Pro League : 18 équipes et la fin des play-offs à partir de la saison 2026-2027|date = 27 February 2025}} ==Teams== [[SK Beveren|Beveren]] was promoted as champions of the [[2025–26 Challenger Pro League]] already in March 2026, returning to the top level after five seasons.{{Cite web|url=https://sporza.be/nl/matches/voetbal/challenger-pro-league/2025-2026/regulier/29/sk-beveren-rwdm-beveren-kampioen-waaslanders-zetten-kroon-op-bijzonder-jaar-met-zege-en-sublieme-goals-tegen-rwdm~1752499811327/|title=Beveren kampioen! Waaslanders zetten kroon op bijzonder jaar met zege (en sublieme goals) tegen RWDM | sporza}} One month later, [[KV Kortrijk|Kortrijk]] took the runners-up spot without playing, as third-placed [[K Beerschot VA|Beerschot]] dropped points away to [[KAS Eupen|Eupen]], making it mathematically certain Kortrijk was also promoted, returning to the top level after just one season.{{Cite web|url=https://sporza.be/nl/matches/voetbal/challenger-pro-league/2025-2026/regulier/33/kas-eupen-beerschot-de-tweede-promovendus-is-bekend-kortrijk-stijgt-naar-eerste-klasse-na-gelijkmaker-in-95e-minuut-van-eupen-tegen-beerschot~1752670745900/|title=De tweede promovendus is bekend: Kortrijk stijgt naar eerste klasse na gelijkmaker in 95e minuut van Eupen tegen Beerschot | sporza}} On 23 May 2026, [[Lommel SK|Lommel]] gained promotion for the first time under its current name and 23 years after predecessor [[KFC Lommel SK]], following a 3–2 victory on aggregate in the promotion/relegation play-off final against [[F.C.V. Dender E.H.|Dender]].{{cite web |last=Joosten |first=Ward |url=https://www.hln.be/belgisch-voetbal/lommel-promoveert-naar-de-jupiler-pro-league-dender-komt-op-eigen-veld-niet-verder-dan-gelijkspel-en-degradeert-naar-1b~a6fb4d12/ |title=Lommel promoveert naar de Jupiler Pro League!
